# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- **Titles:** master  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>; teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Phillips  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache that he frequently curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He is prone to spasmodic fits of reform and keeps poor order in the schoolhouse. He shows clear partiality toward his older students, often neglecting the younger children to focus his attention on those preparing for advanced examinations or those he is courting. He can be sarcastic, severe, and inconsistent with his punishments.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- partial  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>

- teaching algebra and Latin  <sub>[v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>
- reciting Mark Antony's oration  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

- prepare older scholars for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school, where he spent much of his time giving extra attention and lessons to Prissy Andrews, whom he openly courted. Early in Anne Shirley's school days, he humiliated her by forcing her to stand at the blackboard with her name misspelled after she struck Gilbert Blythe for teasing her. On a subsequent day, he singled Anne out for being late and ordered her to sit with Gilbert as punishment, prompting Anne to temporarily leave the school. After a period of initial friction, he praised Anne's academic progress to Matthew Cuthbert, though he continued to criticize her geometry skills. At the school concert, he recited Mark Antony's oration while directing his performance toward Prissy Andrews. He departed from his role at Avonlea school at the end of June, delivering an emotional farewell speech to the students before leaving town.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P45](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0045), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P77](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0077), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- boarded at Eben Wright's house while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- secured his teaching position because his uncle was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
